backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Somers Scheduler backend, defining data models and state for user profiles, stats, availability, posts, reactions, daily logs, and badges, with access control and blob storage mixins included.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping four implemented features (badge progress display, clickable leaderboard player modals, Games Played column, paginated match history) to their corresponding frontend source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated text file containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key changes of components, pages, and hooks across the React application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, muted, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Somers Scheduler PWA, configuring viewport, theme color, PWA manifest, favicon, iOS home screen icons, and splash screen images before mounting the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA web app manifest for Somers Scheduler, specifying app name, display mode, theme/background colors, orientation, and icon URLs for 192x192, 512x512, and maskable sizes.
frontend/public/offline.html: Static offline fallback page displayed by the service worker when the user has no internet connection, featuring a styled message and a retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing install/activate lifecycle with precaching of core assets and a network-first fetch strategy with offline fallback, skipping IC/ICP network traffic.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component that sets up TanStack Router routes and an AuthGate component handling Internet Identity authentication, actor initialization, profile loading, leaderboard initialization, and error/loading states.
frontend/src/components/admin/BadgeManag: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting badge definitions with support for multiple criteria types (wins, streaks, chat messages, etc.) and a form with dynamic threshold fields.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Simple screen displayed when a non-admin user attempts to access a restricted admin page, with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login page with a background image, app logo, and an Internet Identity sign-in button that shows a loading state while authenticating.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Small presentational component that renders the app logo image using branding configuration with a configurable CSS class.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Chat panel component that displays a threaded post list, handles sending new messages with optional image attachments, and shows upload progress.
frontend/src/components/chat/DeleteMessa: Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a chat message, with a disabled state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: File picker component for attaching images to chat messages, with local preview, validation, and a clear button.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Renders like/dislike buttons for a post with optimistic UI updates, calling addReaction/removeReaction mutations and reverting on error.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: Form component for composing and submitting a reply to a parent post, supporting optional image attachments with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Recursively renders a threaded tree of posts with support for inline editing, deletion, reactions, and reply composition, indenting nested replies visually.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Displays a destructive alert with an optional retry button and secondary action button for error states.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides two loading spinner components: a full-page centered spinner and an inline spinner with configurable size.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component that wraps pages with an offline banner, top bar, navigation, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Horizontal navigation bar with links to Calendar, Leaderboard, Profile, and conditionally Admin (for admin users), highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Reusable page layout primitives: a centered max-width container (Page) and a header row with icon, title, and optional action (PageHeader).
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: App header displaying the logo, app name, theme toggle, PWA install button, and a user avatar dropdown with logout, conditionally shown when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/leaderboard/Play: A modal dialog that displays a player's profile including their avatar, stats, win/loss chart, streaks, and earned badges, fetched via query hooks using the player's principal.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileB: Displays a user's earned and unearned badges with icons, progress bars, and color coding, fetching badge definitions and earned badge IDs via query hooks.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: A profile card component that allows the current user to edit their display name and upload a custom avatar image, with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the current user's all-time leaderboard rank by finding their position in the fetched leaderboard data.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the current user's paginated match history sorted by date, displaying wins and losses per day with navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A blocking modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their display name before proceeding, saving the profile on submission.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileW: A bar chart component that visualizes a user's wins and losses over selectable time ranges (week, month, year, all-time) using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: A dialog component that shows step-by-step PWA installation instructions, with separate flows for iOS (Share → Add to Home Screen) and Android/other browsers (menu → Install App).
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: A fixed top banner component that listens to browser online/offline events and displays a warning message with a WifiOff icon when the user loses network connectivity.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: A layout wrapper component that renders a fixed, low-opacity court image as a background behind its children using a CSS background image.
A reusable component that displays a user's avatar (with image or initials fallback) alongside their display name, supporting sm/md/lg sizes and a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, and invalidates all dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks for fetching the current caller's user profile and saving/updating it via the backend actor, with React Query for caching and invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides hooks to query the current caller's user role and admin status from the backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: A hook that manages PWA installation state by detecting standalone mode, iOS devices, and the beforeinstallprompt event, and exposes a promptInstall function to trigger the native install dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: A collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profiles, leaderboard, availability, posts, and other data, all gated on actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: A hook that manages light/dark theme state, persisting the preference to localStorage and toggling the 'dark' class on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and cache user display names and avatars from the backend actor by principal, with fallback to truncated principal strings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS entry point that sets up Tailwind directives, CSS custom properties for light/dark theming, and safe-area/layout utilities.
frontend/src/lib/badgeProgress.ts: Computes progress toward badge criteria (wins, streaks, games played, etc.) from user stats and match history, returning current/required/percentage values.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports a single BRANDING constant object containing the app name, logo URL, and logo alt text for the Somers Scheduler app.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Builds a nested thread tree from a flat list of posts and provides a utility to flatten it with depth metadata for rendering.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting between Date objects and compact numeric day IDs, generating calendar grids, and formatting dates/timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page component for adding or editing a user's availability for a specific date, with time selectors and notes input backed by a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel page that displays registered users and their availabilities in tables, with delete actions for both, protected by an admin role check.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view page showing a grid of days with availability counts per day, plus a chat panel below; supports month navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page that renders the group chat panel with a full-height layout.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a specific calendar day showing all users available on that date, with options to add, edit, or delete the caller's own availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard page displaying ranked players with win/loss recording controls, win streak computation, rank-change toast notifications, and a player profile modal.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing stats cards, match history, win/loss chart, badges, leaderboard ranks, and computed current/best win streaks.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utility functions for file handling: converting a File/Blob to Uint8Array, extracting name initials, and validating image file type and size.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Utility functions for time input handling, including generating hour/minute/period options, formatting time strings, and parsing them into structured components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file describing a sports/gaming app's current features, pending feature requests (badge progress, leaderboard modals, chat reactions, admin analytics), and known build issues.
